params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 50, max 100.

params.name: withTotalCount
params.description: When true, includes totalCount in the response for pagination.

params.name: actions
params.description: Filter by one or more action types (comma-separated, e.g. `actions=CREATE_PAT` or `actions=CREATE_PAT,DELETE_PAT`).

params.name: identitySubject
params.description: Filter by the identity subject who performed the action.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter events created after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter events created before this date (ISO 8601).

items.docs: Get paginated security audit log for a team. Requires team admin permissions.
